app.account: Account (sign-in comes with a later version)
app.closed: nexlore is closed: accounts come with a later version. A test server can be opened with NEXLORE_UNSAFE_OPEN_ACCESS.

graph.hint: Scroll to zoom · click a folder to open it · double click opens a note · Ctrl K searches
graph.empty: No notes yet. Create a space under Settings, import an Obsidian vault under Files, or put Markdown files into the vault folder.

note.lockedTitle: {{name}} is editing this note right now
note.lockedBanner: {{name}} is editing this note right now. You can read it; editing works once they are done.
note.pick: Pick a note on the left, or search with Ctrl K.
note.renameHint: Links to this note in other notes follow the new name.
note.conflict: The note was changed elsewhere while you were writing. Nothing was overwritten; your text is in the copy
note.readonlyTitle: This file is not UTF-8 text
note.readonlyBanner: This file is not UTF-8 text. It is shown, but saving it here could lose characters, so it stays read-only.

settings.title: Settings
settings.sketch: Sketch in the mockup: nothing here is saved yet.

language.title: Language
language.text: English and German come with nexlore. The operator can add more as JSON files in data/locales; whatever a file leaves out appears in English.
language.templateHint: The English texts as a file to translate. Save it as data/locales/<code>.json, for example es.json or pt-BR.json.

signin.title: Sign-in
signin.text: Accounts with a password, plus an OIDC provider. Whoever signs in through OIDC for the first time gets an account.

spaces.title: Spaces and rights
spaces.text: A space is a folder on disk. Whoever may not see it sees nothing of it in the graph, the search or the backlinks either, not even the title.

mcp.title: AI access (MCP)
mcp.text: Lets AI assistants search, read and write notes. Every key belongs to an account and sees only what that account may see.
mcp.allowHint: Off by default. The operator turns it on for everybody.

mode.draftsText: New notes and changes are marked as AI drafts until you accept them.
mode.writeText: Like a person with the right to write. Every change is in the history.

plugins.title: Plugins
plugins.text: Plugins run locked away in the browser and see only what they ask for when installed. They may not go online.

right.writeOpen: reads and writes the open note

calendar.name: Calendar
calendar.text: Daily notes as a month view.

mermaid.name: Mermaid diagrams
mermaid.text: Draws ```mermaid blocks in the reading view.

kanban.name: Kanban board
kanban.text: A note with headings as columns.

templates.name: Templates
templates.text: A new note from a template, with date and placeholders.

readingTime.name: Reading time
readingTime.text: Shows under the title how long reading takes.

byCode.locale_unusable: This language file cannot be used.
byCode.internal_error: Something went wrong on the server.
byCode.path_too_long: The name or path is too long.
byCode.name_invalid: This name cannot be used: it holds a character or a form Windows, macOS or Linux cannot store.
byCode.exists: Something of that name exists already.
byCode.locked: Somebody else is editing this note.
byCode.not_a_note: This file is not a note.
byCode.move_across_spaces: Notes move within their space only.
byCode.too_large_for_trash: The file is too large for the trash.
byCode.archive_invalid: This is not a ZIP archive.
byCode.archive_unsafe: The archive holds an entry that would end up outside its folder. Nothing was unpacked.
byCode.archive_too_many_files: The archive holds too many files.

files.title: Files
files.intro: The Markdown files are the truth. Here: the index over them, the trash, and bringing in an Obsidian vault.

index.title: Index
index.text: nexlore watches the vault folder and reads every change, also those made by Obsidian, Syncthing or an editor. A full pass every few minutes catches what the watcher missed.
index.heldBack: Most files of {{spaces}} vanished at once. nexlore did not move them to the trash, because a folder that is not mounted looks just like that.

trash.title: Trash
trash.text: Deleted notes stay here for 30 days with their history, then they go for good. Notes deleted outside nexlore land here too.
trash.purgeConfirm: Delete “{{path}}” for good? This cannot be undone.

import.title: Import an Obsidian vault
import.text: A ZIP of the vault becomes a new space. .obsidian and plugin syntax come along untouched; the report says what nexlore shows as code instead of running it.
import.name: Name of the new space

report.notUtf8: Files that are not UTF-8 text (read-only)
report.caseTwins: Names that differ only in case
